question: Does restoring native end-to-end score coupling to C127 B6 exact dual-oracle geometry improve both deployed top1 ADE and top1 FDE while retaining the oracle ADE/FDE gain?

hypotheses.primary: J1_joint_coupled_dual improves top1 ADE and top1 FDE over matched C127 B0 and does not regress minADE or minFDE versus B0.
hypotheses.mechanism: The native score head and the two geometry heads co-adapt through the same mode features while the geometry loss still assigns independent ADE and FDE winners.
hypotheses.rival: The detached C128 scorer failed because B6 candidate geometry is intrinsically hard to rank, so restoring shared-feature gradients will not beat B0.
hypotheses.null: Joint coupling either fails to improve both top1 metrics or sacrifices either oracle geometry metric.

dataset.name: trajair_111day_c12
dataset.access_policy: C129 train-date screening may open only processed_data/train. The consumed locked test and the open development split are unavailable to this implementation.

model.base: ASCENT positive_speed_pitch with native shared mode head

screening.execution_order: Run fold 0 first. Folds 1 and 2 are replication runs only after the frozen fold-0 gate passes.
screening.matched_controls: Reuse completed C127 B0 and B6 fold checkpoints and metrics; do not retrain controls.
screening.failure_rule: Stop C129 immediately when fold 0 fails any gate; do not compensate with seeds, temperatures, weights, epochs, or post-selection.

claim_boundary: C129 is train-only blocked algorithm screening. No development or sealed-test claim is authorized.
